_what: Vendor-published per-user decode rates of SRAM-resident machines, each quoted from its page. spatial_decode_lock prices the published model on the fewest chips that hold it (the strictest floor any deployment of it has, since collective latencies are undeclared) and requires the published rate never to beat that floor. The shapes come from a GGUF header of the same model; bytes_per_weight is the published weight precision.
